node.statement: Let breve-V be breve-sigma-fixed. Since breve-calU=calU_e/U(1), choose U_0 in calU_e with [U_0]=breve-V. Using breve-sigma([U])=[sigma(U)] from node 1.1, fixedness gives [sigma(U_0)]=[U_0]; by the defining scalar-orbit equivalence of this quotient, there is c in U(1) such that sigma(U_0)=c*U_0.
